first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: stack of brown cardboard boxes
entities.identification: A collection of stacks in the storage room composed of multiple brown rectangular cardboard boxes, with text, barcodes, and handling icons visible on the box surfaces.

entities.name: Vehicle A
entities.identification: A narrow two-tier cart on the right side of the storage room, with cyan-green trays and a silver tubular metal frame.

entities.name: black horizontal-bar grille
entities.identification: A structure of black horizontal bars and vertical frames on the side of the storage room, with bright bands and rows of bottle-shaped products between the bars.

entities.name: group of white product shelves
entities.identification: White multi-tier display racks and endcap racks inside the store, with long rows of racks extending in a straight line into the store.

entities.name: white grid-patterned suspended ceiling
entities.identification: A flat grid-patterned suspended ceiling above the store, composed of white square panels and thin gray seams.

entities.name: store interior light gray floor
entities.identification: The flat light gray floor within the doorway and beside the store shelves, with soft reflections and fine linear seams.

entities.name: black-bordered doorway
entities.identification: A vertical rectangular opening connecting the storage room to the brightly lit store, with dark borders on the left side and upper edge.

entities.name: storage room dark-colored floor
entities.identification: The dark gray, nearly black, flat floor in the storage room, with conspicuous glossy reflections in some areas.

entities.name: storage room grayish-white wall
entities.identification: The grayish-white vertical wall surfaces of the storage room, mottled in some areas, with the lower section of the rear wall darker.

entities.name: storage room dark gray flat ceiling
entities.identification: At frame 0, the continuous dark gray flat ceiling surface covering the upper part of the storage room and adjoining the surrounding walls.

entities.name: recessed rectangular light panel
entities.identification: Multiple rectangular white light panels in the store's grid-patterned suspended ceiling, with dark narrow frames visible around the illuminated surfaces.

entities.name: store entrance light-colored door panel
entities.identification: An open light beige-gray flat-panel door on the right side of the black-bordered doorway, with a circular metal handle on its surface.
